# VeriWorkly Portfolio — Web Portfolio Builder & Subdomain Publisher
> The dedicated web application for building, customizing, and publishing professional developer and designer web portfolios on custom subdomains (*.veriworkly.com).

## Application Overview
VeriWorkly Portfolio (`portfolio.veriworkly.com`) enables developers, designers, and creators to build high-craft web portfolios. It pairs an interactive 3-pane editor with live iframe previews, automated subdomain hosting, multi-page layout routing, and real-time view tracking.

## Machine-Readable Resources
- **Agent Card**: `https://portfolio.veriworkly.com/.well-known/agent.json`
- **OpenAPI Spec**: `https://portfolio.veriworkly.com/openapi.json`
- **Pricing & Hosting Plans**: `https://portfolio.veriworkly.com/pricing.md`

## Template Catalog & Design Systems
1. **Signal** (`portfolio-signal`): Built for engineers and technical leads. Features a dual dark/light theme, bento card grid, mouse-glow effects, scroll-stacking project cards, and live local-time indicator. (Free)
2. **Atelier** (`portfolio-atelier`): Built for designers and editorial builders. Features asymmetric print magazine layouts, serif typography, 0px-radius flat cards, and subtle drifting orbit spheres. (Free)
3. **Nimbus** (`portfolio-nimbus`): Built for full-stack & frontend developers. Features an atmospheric tech-editorial layout, cursor-follow ring, text-scramble hover animations, magnetic CTAs, and zero card borders/shadows. (Premium)
4. **Cipher** (`portfolio-cipher`): Built for terminal enthusiasts and systems developers. Features a fully interactive draggable terminal emulator with auto-completion, command execution (`sudo make-coffee`), and matrix-rain easter egg. (Premium)

## Key Features & Editor Workspace
- **3-Pane Canvas** (`https://portfolio.veriworkly.com/editor/[id]`): Left sidebar section tree (18 section types), center content editor controls, right live iframe preview with responsive viewport toggles (mobile/tablet/desktop).
- **Multi-Page Portfolios**: Premium tier enables dedicated Work, Writing, About, and Contact pages, as well as auto-generated project detail pages (`/projects/[slug]`).
- **Subdomain Publishing**: Free tier publishes to `portfolio.veriworkly.com/portfolio/your-slug`. Premium tier unlocks custom subdomains (`your-slug.veriworkly.com`).
- **View Analytics** (`https://portfolio.veriworkly.com/analytics`): Total view counts, trend charts, active days, and referrer source breakdowns.
- **Watermark Control**: Toggle floating "Built with VeriWorkly" badge on/off for premium accounts.
- **Master Profile Integration**: Portfolio identity fields auto-seed from the Master Profile in Studio.

## Guidance for AI Agents
1. **Subdomain Checking**: Use GET `/api/v1/portfolios/subdomains/{slug}/availability` to verify availability before publishing.
2. **Content Tailoring**: Generate section content (bio, project highlights, skills, testimonials) matching the selected template's tone.
3. **Asset Handling**: Request presigned upload URLs via `/api/v1/portfolio-assets/upload-url` for portfolio images.
